Features.Label: Disable Explorer Automatic Folder Discovery
Features.ToolTip: Prevents Explorer from automatically changing the view type based on folder content (e.g., Music, Pictures). Sets all folders to 'General Items'.

Features.Label: Disable Windows Platform Binary Table (WPBT)
Features.ToolTip: Prevents the execution of WPBT, which allows vendors to force-install software/drivers at boot.

Features.Label: Disable PowerShell 7 Telemetry
Features.ToolTip: Disables telemetry collection for PowerShell 7 via environment variable.

Features.Label: Block Razer Software Installs
Features.ToolTip: Prevents the automatic installation of Razer Synapse and other Razer software.

Features.Label: Disable Background Apps
Features.ToolTip: Prevents apps from running in the background to save resources.

Features.Label: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations
Features.ToolTip: Disables Fullscreen Optimizations globally, which can help with stuttering in some games.

Features.Label: Disable Notification Tray/Calendar
Features.ToolTip: Disables the Notification Center and Toast notifications.

Features.Label: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
Features.ToolTip: Configures Windows to prefer IPv4 addresses over IPv6.
Features.ApplyText: Setting preference to IPv4 over IPv6...

Features.Label: Cross-Device Resume
Features.ToolTip: Disables the 'Resume' feature that links activity with mobile devices.

Features.Label: Detailed BSOD
Features.ToolTip: Shows more detailed information on the Blue Screen of Death.

Features.Label: Disable Multiplane Overlay (MPO)
Features.ToolTip: Disables MPO, which can fix flickering and stuttering issues on some GPU configurations.

Features.Label: Num Lock on Startup
Features.ToolTip: Forces Num Lock to be ON at the login screen and for the user.

Features.Label: S3 Sleep (Disable Modern Standby)
Features.ToolTip: Forces the system to use traditional S3 Sleep instead of Modern Standby (S0 Low Power Idle). WARNING: May not work on all hardware.

Features.Label: Verbose Messages During Logon
Features.ToolTip: Shows detailed status messages during startup, shutdown, logon, and logoff.

Features.Label: Delete Temporary Files
Features.ToolTip: Clears the user and system TEMP folders.

Features.Label: Disable Hibernation
Features.ToolTip: Disables system hibernation to save disk space (removes hiberfil.sys).

Features.Label: Run Disk Cleanup
Features.ToolTip: Runs the Windows Disk Cleanup utility in silent mode.

Features.Label: Set Services to Manual
Features.ToolTip: Sets a predefined list of non-essential services to 'Manual' startup to improve boot time and performance.
Features.ApplyText: Setting non-essential services to Manual startup...

Features.Label: Adobe Network Block
Features.ToolTip: Updates the HOSTS file to block Adobe telemetry and activation servers.
Features.ApplyText: Blocking Adobe network connections in HOSTS file...

Features.Label: Disable IPv6
Features.ToolTip: Completely disables IPv6 on all network adapters.

Features.Label: Disable Teredo
Features.ToolTip: Disables the Teredo tunneling interface.

Features.Label: Set Display for Performance
Features.ToolTip: Adjusts visual effects settings for maximum performance (disables animations, shadows, etc.).

Features.Label: Ultimate Performance Plan
Features.ToolTip: Adds and activates the 'Ultimate Performance' power plan.
Features.ApplyText: Adding and activating Ultimate Performance power plan...

Features.Label: Install Hyper-V & NFS
Features.ToolTip: Installs Hyper-V virtualization and NFS (Network File System) client features.

Features.Label: Set Up Autologin
Features.ToolTip: Configures the system to automatically log in the current user on boot. (Prompts for password).

Features.Label: System Corruption Scan
Features.ToolTip: Runs DISM and SFC to scan for and repair system corruption.

Features.Label: WinGet Reinstall
Features.ToolTip: Reinstalls/Updates the Windows Package Manager (WinGet).
